rows.en:
And then Ponkichi was found by the boy who'd been taking care of it.
"Ponkichi! Ponkichi☆"
He hurriedly grabbed its tail and pulled Ponkichi out.
But Ponkichi had already breathed its last.
He grieved.
"Who would do something this horrible..."
Thinking he could at least give it a grave, he made one beside that restroom and buried it there.{p}

Then a few days went by.
All that time, he never once missed visiting the grave.{p}

That day after school, too, he went over to the restroom to visit the grave.
And there was someone wrecking the grave.
Furious, he ran right up to the guy.
"What do you think you're doing?!"
His face bright red, he told him off.
But the guy just got angry right back and punched him.
And then he said,
"I'm the one who killed the tanuki,"
just like that.
When he heard that, he went at the guy with his fists.
But he was no match for him at all.{p}

Instead, he got beaten to a pulp and dragged inside the restroom.
The guy must have figured he could beat him as much as he liked where no one would see.
And he kept on beating him.
So badly that the whole restroom was covered in blood.
Just as he was about to lose consciousness...{p}

Suddenly, the guy started to look terrified of something.
"Whoa, what the hell is that?!
Stay back, stay the hell away from me☆"
Wondering what was happening, he desperately forced his eyes open to look.
And then...{p}

Would you believe it, the tanuki's ghost was standing there.
"Ponkichi..."
And then he passed out.
He'd taken a terrible beating, after all.{p}

Unbelievably, the guy who'd killed Ponkichi was dead, with his head jammed into a toilet bowl.
It was exactly the way Ponkichi had died.{p}

Then, scared, he hurried home.
Making sure no one saw him.{p}

After that - he'd been beaten pretty badly too, you see - he stayed home from school until the swelling went down.
When he finally went back, everyone was talking about the mysterious body of a boy student.
For some reason, he'd died with his head jammed into a toilet bowl, where a head should never fit.
Apparently his head was crushed to a pulp.
So badly that no one would have known who he was without his student handbook.
People said it was nothing a human being could have done.
And you know, his uniform was covered in tanuki fur.{p}

So the rumors started.
That some unknown monster haunted that restroom.
And that the monster took the form of a tanuki.
That's why everyone stopped using that restroom.
...Actually, this story isn't over yet.{p}Do you want to hear it?
Not that much
I'd love to hear it

Okay, got it. Then I'll tell you.
The boy who'd taken care of Ponkichi figured Ponkichi must have gotten its revenge.
And that it had avenged him, too.
Overjoyed, he made Ponkichi a grave all over again.
Ever since it had been wrecked, he hadn't tended to it at all.
And for a while, peaceful days went on.{p}

One day, he was visiting Ponkichi's grave as usual.
Then he needed to use the restroom.
Right beside him was the restroom rumored to be haunted by that monster.
But he didn't believe in any monster.
Of course he didn't.
He knew it was Ponkichi's ghost that had killed the guy who killed Ponkichi.
So he went to that restroom, the closest one.{p}

While he was doing his business there, he heard something like a puppy whimpering.
"What's that sound..."{p}
It didn't sound like just one of them crying.{p}

It sounded like several of something were crying.
He looked all around, but there was nothing there.
But the cries were definitely coming from inside the restroom.
Getting creeped out, he started to leave the restroom.
"Huh..."{p}

He felt something nuzzle up against his feet.
He looked down at his feet.
And there, you see, were several tanuki cubs.
They were tiny cubs, no more than a month old.
The cubs were rubbing their bodies against him, as if begging to be petted.
"Aww, you're so cute...
What's the matter?
What are you doing in a place like this..."
He reached out to pet the cubs.
He must have been reminded of Ponkichi and found them just too adorable.
"There, there, good babies, good babies..."
The instant he held out his hand!{p}

"Agh☆"
One of the cubs had bitten his finger.
On reflex, he flailed his hand around.
Trying to shake off the cub that had bitten him.
That's when something felt strange to him.
The cub biting him felt oddly light.
He couldn't feel any weight at all.
He looked at the cub on the end of his hand.{p}

"Wha- Waaah!"
Would you believe it, the cub biting his fingertip had turned into something like a mummy.
In a panic, he tore the cub mummy off his fingertip.
It was a tanuki cub, or rather, a carcass like one, bone-dry like a piece of dried fish.
Wherever he gripped it to pull it off, the cub crumbled away in pieces.
He flung away the mummy he was holding.
It was just too ghastly.
The cubs at his feet had turned into withered mummies the same way.
Cubs that had been alive just a moment ago had become dried-up corpses in an instant.
His legs shook so badly he couldn't move.
And then, you know, the dried-up corpses started to move.
Toward him.{p}

He practically leapt into the air and ran out of the restroom.
They say that's when he heard voices crying, I'm starving, I'm starving.
Only when he'd fled as far as the shoe lockers did the voices finally stop.
"What the hell was that just now..."
He wanted to believe it had been a hallucination.
But the blood running from his fingertip said otherwise.
After that, he got it treated at the nurse's office and went home.{p}
That night.{p}

He was asleep when the sound of something crying from somewhere woke him.
It sounded like the cubs he'd heard crying in that restroom during the day.
He pulled the covers over his head and shook all over.
Remembering those dried-up tanuki.
"Go away!
What did I ever do to you?!
Don't come near meeee☆"
He screamed, covering his ears.{p}

But the crying wouldn't stop at all.
And then he realized.{p}

Now it was coming from around his right hand.
As he hurriedly jerked his right hand back, he realized.
The crying was coming from the bite wound.
Fearfully, he took the bandage off the wound.
And then...{p}
The wound was moving, opening and closing like a little mouth, and the crying was coming out of it.{p}

"Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!"
He screamed at the top of his lungs.
His own hand had turned into that, so of course he'd be shocked.
His father and mother heard the scream and were startled.
They rushed to his room.
And they say that, right then, he was stabbing his hand over and over with a pair of scissors.
No matter how hard they tried to hold him down, he threw them off and kept stabbing it, apparently.{p}

After that, apparently he was in the hospital for a while.
He'd had a nervous breakdown, they say.
So people decided the rumor about the monster was true.
Even now, nobody goes near the place, they say.
But I wonder why tanuki cubs showed up there.
Strange, isn't it?
Maybe it has something to do with Ponkichi.
But that doesn't really matter, does it?
Either way, something shows up there.
In fact, I hear it still does, even now.
Around March this year, they tried to tear that restroom down.
And three of the workers who came for the job died mysterious deaths.
Even though they'd had it properly exorcised.
I'm thinking of looking into that restroom myself sometime.
When I do, will you come too, {a}{f:|}?
I'd feel nervous going all by myself.{p}

Let's go together.
I'm looking forward to it.
Or do you want to go right now?
Hahahaha, just kidding. Just kidding.
But let's go sometime.
Ah, now I've got one more thing to look forward to.
I'm so happy.{p}

"All right, I sentence you to be burned at the stake."
The guy tied the tanuki's paws together and hung it up in the doorway of a stall.
Then he went and got some matches from over by the incinerator.
Along with some newspaper that was lying there.
He rolled the newspaper up into a stick and set it on fire.{p}

Then he brought it close to Ponkichi.
A scream went up, a scream beyond words.
Ponkichi writhed from the heat.
The scorched fur on its back gave off a hideous smell.
"Come on, come on, is it hot?
If it's hot, then go 'Pon!'"
Spouting nonsense like that, the guy kept on tormenting Ponkichi.{p}

"I'm starting to get bored.
...I know, I just had a great idea!"
The guy rolled newspaper into a stick and shoved it into Ponkichi's mouth.
And then... he set that newspaper on fire.{p}

Smoke filled its mouth, and Ponkichi suffered.
It tried to spit it out, but with its mouth stuffed full of newspaper, it couldn't.
And little by little, the fire spread toward its mouth.
...How about it, {a}{f:|}?
Try imagining you're Ponkichi.
Your mouth is stuffed full of newspaper, and then it's set on fire.
Smoke from the newspaper spreads through your mouth.
You want to cough, but the newspaper filling your mouth won't let you.
Little by little, the fire spreads.
The tip of your nose sizzles and burns.
In a situation like that, if you breathed in, I bet the flames would come right up your nose.
It's unbearably hot, but your hands are tied, and there's nothing you can do.
And then the fire reaches your lips and starts to char them...
Could you stand it?
I don't think I could.
Just thinking about it gives me goosebumps.
That's exactly how Ponkichi was tortured.{p}

The newspaper shoved in its mouth finally burned itself out.
Ponkichi's mouth hung slack, its eyes rolled back to the whites, and it was twitching.
The fur around its mouth had burned away, leaving the bare skin exposed.
But that skin was charred a dark, dirty black, with patches of red left here and there.
Its mouth had shriveled up from the burning, baring its charred gums.
Its blackened tongue had gone stiff and hung limply out of its mouth.{p}
Fighting back the urge to throw up, the guy left the restroom.{p}

And then Ponkichi was found by the boy who'd been taking care of it.
"Ponkichi! Ponkichi☆"
Ponkichi was dead, still hanging there.
He felt so sorry for Ponkichi, dying such a horrible death.
He made a grave for it beside the restroom.{p}

Then a few days went by.
All that time, he never once missed visiting the grave.{p}

That day after school, too, he went over to the restroom to visit the grave.
And there was someone wrecking the grave.
Furious, he ran right up to the guy.
"What do you think you're doing?!"
His face bright red, he told him off.
But the guy just got angry right back and punched him.
And then he said,
"I'm the one who killed the tanuki,"
just like that.
When he heard that, he went at the guy with his fists.
But he was no match for him at all.{p}

Instead, he got beaten to a pulp and dragged into the restroom.
The guy must have figured he'd beat him all he liked, where no one could see.
And he kept on beating him.
So much that the whole restroom ended up covered in blood.{p}
After that, he stayed home from school for a few days, until the swelling went down.{p}

And when he went back to school, everyone was talking about a certain boy student.
They said a boy had burned himself to death in the restroom next to the gym.
And that boy was the guy who'd killed Ponkichi.
Apparently a student doing club practice in the gym found him.
They noticed a strange smell and went to the restroom, and there the boy was, burned to death by his own hand, they said.
Strangely, only his head had burned, apparently.{p}

And they say there was a tanuki in the restroom at the time.
There was even a rumor that the tanuki vanished into thin air as it ran off.
After that, all sorts of rumors about that restroom flew around.
That the ghost of the student who killed himself appears there, or that the tanuki's spirit possesses whoever comes in and makes them kill themselves...
So no one would use that restroom anymore.
That's how it is.
...Actually, there's more to this story.{p}Do you want to hear it?
That's enough, thanks
I'd love to hear it, please

So they decided to tear it down, but everyone who came to do the work got possessed by something.
Of course, they had it exorcised before starting the work.
But it didn't do any good.
The school blocked off the entrance too, so students wouldn't use that restroom, but before anyone knew it, it would get broken.
The screen at the entrance, I mean.
So they decided to just leave it alone.
Even if no one said anything, nobody was going to use that restroom anyway.
And that's how the incident ended up happening.{p}

I've got a friend, you see, a guy named Keiichi Tsuda.
This is something that happened to him.{p}

In the middle of P.E. class, he needed to go to the restroom.
He knew the rumors about that restroom too, right?
So he was holding it in.
But finally he couldn't hold it any longer.
So he had no choice: he told the teacher and went to that restroom.
A little while later...{p}

"What's wrong, Tsuda?!"
When I rushed into the restroom, Tsuda was standing there like nothing had happened.
He was just on his way out of the stall.
"What's the matter, Hosoda?
Why the frantic look..."
"What's the matter? I just heard a scream from inside the restroom, so..."
"I didn't scream or anything.
Weren't you just dreaming?
Hahahaha."{p}

With that, he went back to the gym.
I thought it was weird, but I went back to the gym too.
At the time, I didn't notice at all.
That he had changed.
Until then, Tsuda had been very quiet, not the type to take the initiative.
And yet, all of a sudden, he'd become really outgoing.{p}

At first I didn't notice.
But you know, as the days went by, he kept changing more and more.
He'd never been popular with girls, but suddenly he was a big hit and all.
Anyway, he became like a completely different person.
So, you know, I asked him.
What had happened to him.
He grinned and answered.
"I've got something good to tell you.
I guess I can tell you, Hosoda."{p}

Tsuda said he wanted me to come with him, and started walking.
I hurried after him.
He headed toward the gym.
And when we got to the gym, he walked straight to that restroom.
I was shocked.
Not long before, Tsuda had hated going to that restroom too, and now he was walking right in on his own.
Honestly, I didn't want to go into that restroom.
But Tsuda told me to follow him, so I had no choice but to go along.{p}

Once we were inside, he started talking.
"Hosoda, it seems you're worried that I've changed.
You don't need to worry about it.
It was unpleasant at first, but... you get used to it soon enough.
Heh heh heh heh heh..."
It was a really creepy laugh.
A laugh that stuck strangely in your ears.
{a}{f:|}, do you know the phrase "desire for transformation"?
It's the desire to become a self different from who you are...
You have it too, don't you, {a}{f:|}?
That kind of desire.
Tsuda asked me about it too, in that restroom.
And I answered that sometimes I do wish I could be a different me.
Tsuda laughed, looking pleased.
I could hardly believe my eyes.
There were dark rings around Tsuda's eyes.
Just like a tanuki's.{p}

I remembered that rumor.
The rumor that a tanuki haunts this restroom.
I hadn't really believed it, but it was true.
And Tsuda seemed to be possessed by that tanuki.
He must have been possessed when I heard that scream.
I suddenly got scared.
Of being all alone with Tsuda.
There was no telling what he might do to me.
I excused myself to Tsuda and tried to hurry out of the restroom.
Just then.
Tsuda let out an eerie laugh.
"Heh heh heh heh heh..."
Just like that.
I felt a horrible chill run down my back, and I turned around.{p}

"Waaah!"
A giant tanuki was leaping right at me.
Like this, see.
Hosoda loomed over {f:me|me} as if to throw himself on top of me.
"Whoa!"
Carelessly, {f:I|I} let myself get startled.
Because Hosoda's face looked just like a tanuki's.{p}

And there was only Tsuda, standing there with a blank, dazed look on his face.
"Tsuda..."
Worried that Tsuda still hadn't moved after all that time, I spoke to him.
Even so, Tsuda didn't so much as twitch.
I had a bad feeling.
I ran right over to him and shook him by the shoulders.{p}

"☆"
Tsuda collapsed, as if whatever had been propping him up was gone.
I hurried to tell a teacher.
And he ended up in the hospital.{p}

Maybe the tanuki that possessed him devoured Tsuda's sense of self.
I guess Tsuda's sense of self must have been weak.
And then the tanuki left him, so he was left an empty shell.
That's what I think, anyway.{p}

He said that being possessed feels unpleasant, but after a while you get used to it.
At first, you don't notice.
That you've been possessed...
As time passes, you start to understand.
That inside your head there's a you that's different from before.
And then you start to feel kind of uneasy.
Afraid you might turn into someone different from who you've been.
But you get used to it soon enough, he said.{p}

Now I understand it too, what he meant...
You'll understand it too someday, won't you, {a}{f:|}...
Heh heh heh heh heh...
...{f:Huh|Ugh}, what is Hosoda talking about, {f:anyway|I wonder}?
There's no way {f:I|I} could know how a possessed person feels...
As {f:I|I} stood there bewildered, Hosoda said:
...What's wrong?
You look like a pigeon that just got hit with a peashooter.
Even if you don't understand what I mean now, you'll come to understand eventually.
Heh heh heh heh heh...
Well, my story's over.{p}

Finally, we're down to just one more.
I think we can assume the seventh person isn't coming.
They still haven't shown up, even now.
But maybe that's for the best.
There's no need to force the seven wonders to be completed.
I mean, if we completed them and something terrible happened, it'd be too late by then.{p}

Well, actually, some people really have gone missing,
so maybe something bad has already started happening...{p}
"Very well! I hereby sentence thee to be paraded through town, then crucified, with thy head put on display!"{p}
With that, the guy tied a rope around Ponkichi's neck.{p}

Then he dragged it to the bike racks.
He tied the rope from Ponkichi's neck to his bicycle and started riding toward the walking trail on the hill out back.{p}

He'd gotten it all wrong, you see.
He'd mixed up what 'paraded through town' meant—he thought it meant being dragged around.
He started pedaling as hard as he could along the walking trail, where hardly anyone ever came.
At first, Ponkichi ran for dear life and kept up.
But soon its legs couldn't keep pace, and finally it started being dragged.
Getting carried away, the guy went faster and faster and faster.
Ponkichi shrieked, frantically trying to run.
But once the bike hit the downhill slope, it sped along at a terrific speed.
Ponkichi tumbled belly-down, then back-down, until its whole body was scraped into a raw mess.
By the time the guy had made one lap of the trail on the hill behind the school, Ponkichi had passed out and hung limp.
Apparently all its fur had been torn off, and it was covered in blood.{p}

Even that wasn't enough for the guy. He took it back to the restroom and hung it from the entrance of a stall.
He probably wanted to crucify it, but there was nowhere to nail it up.{p}
"Hey, say something, why don't you."{p}

And then Ponkichi was found by the boy who'd been taking care of it.
"Ponkichi! Ponkichi☆"
Ponkichi was dead, still hanging there.
Covered in blood from head to tail, looking as if it had hanged itself.
"How could anyone do something so horrible?
What would it take to leave it like this..."
He was devastated.
Then he made a grave beside the restroom and buried it.{p}

Then a few days went by.
All that time, he never once missed visiting the grave.{p}

That day after school, too, he went over to the restroom to visit the grave.
And there was someone wrecking the grave.
Furious, he ran right up to the guy.
"What do you think you're doing?!"
His face bright red, he told him off.
But the guy just got angry right back and punched him.
And then he said,
"I'm the one who killed the tanuki,"
just like that.
When he heard that, he went at the guy with his fists.
But he was no match for him at all.{p}

Instead, he got beaten to a pulp and dragged into the restroom.
The guy must have figured he'd beat him all he liked, where no one could see.
And he kept on beating him.
So much that the whole restroom ended up covered in blood.{p}
After that, he stayed home from school for a few days, until the swelling went down.{p}
And when he went back to school, everyone was talking about a certain male student.{p}

On his way home from school on his bike, that student got caught by a dump truck and dragged for several hundred meters.
Naturally, by the time they found him, he was dead.
But you know, according to people who saw him being dragged, he was still alive while it was happening.
They say he was screaming.
Horrible, isn't it?
I wonder what it feels like to be dragged around alive.
It must hurt so much you can't think of anything at all.{p}

That student, see—he was the one who killed Ponkichi.
By coincidence, he died the same way Ponkichi did.
Do you think that's just a coincidence?
I sure don't.{p}

For some reason, they say he's in there, desperately apologizing to something.
"I'm sorry... I'm sorry,"
like that.
So nobody goes near that restroom anymore.{p}
Actually, this story isn't over yet.{p}Would you like to hear the rest, {a}{f:|}?
I've had enough
Please tell me more

Okay, okay, got it.
I'll tell you.{p}

One of the classmates of the boy who looked after the tanuki was a girl named Namiko Yoshida...
Right around when Ponkichi started showing up at school, she stopped coming to school.
He was worried about her.
Because he liked Yoshida, you see.
After a while, a rumor started going around that she'd gone missing.
And it seemed it was no mere rumor, but the truth.
He was terribly worried, but in the end, she was never found.
And then that incident happened.
The one where Ponkichi was killed.{p}

The truth is, he had actually given that tanuki her name.
He could never bring himself to confess his feelings to Yoshida.
So instead, he gave the tanuki her name and doted on it, to fool himself about how he felt.
Pathetic, isn't it...
I guess he got lonely once Yoshida was gone.{p}

He began tending the grave of the tanuki he'd given Yoshida's name even more devotedly than before.
On windy days, on rainy days.
It was as if he meant to keep it up until she really appeared.
And then she really did appear.
She did............
That day, too, after school when everyone had gone, he was tending the grave alone.
That was when someone spoke to him from behind.
"...You always take such good care of it............
Thank you..."{p}

When he turned around, there stood Yoshida.
"Yoshida☆"
Startled, he started to rush over to her.
"Wait.
People will see us here.
This way..."
She led him inside that restroom.{p}

"You took care of the tanuki here, didn't you..."
"Huh..."
He was stunned.
How did she know about that?
After all, she'd gone missing before the tanuki ever showed up at school.
"How do you know that..."
he asked her.{p}

"I was watching the whole time.
Watching you take care of it.
No—I was the one you were taking care of...
...That tanuki was me..."
He was so confused he had no idea what was going on.
"Huh? What?
Wait a second...
I don't understand what you mean..."
"...Yes.
I can't blame you.
It's an unbelievable story, after all.
You see, I'm actually dead.
What's standing here like this is my soul...
What people call a ghost..."
That's right—the one who'd appeared there was Yoshida's ghost.
And she began to talk.
About how she had come to die.{p}

"One day, I found a tanuki.
...At school.
Its leg was badly hurt.
It must have been hit by a car or something.
When I went closer to treat it, it walked off toward the hill out back, as if desperately trying to get away.
It had something like food in its mouth...{p}

The injured tanuki had been bringing food to her cubs.
Coming all the way down to where people live.{p}
On the way, she was hit by a car.{p}

Once the mother tanuki gave her cubs the food, she died, looking relieved.
I felt so sorry for that tanuki.
So I decided to bring them food in her place.
They didn't look like they could find food on their own yet, after all.
Every day, I went up into the hill out back and fed them.{p}

It was a rainy, terribly damp day.
I was bringing them food as usual.
And then... the long rain had loosened the ground...
I slipped and fell down a cliff.
I remember the blood gushing from my head.
That's when I thought it.
I'm going to die.
And if I die, who'll take care of those little ones?
That's what I was thinking about, even as I was dying.
Then the spirit of that injured tanuki appeared before me.
The mother tanuki's love for her cubs and my feelings became one, and a miracle happened.{p}

I came back to life as a tanuki.
Or maybe I possessed some other tanuki.
Either way, I could keep bringing food to those cubs.
And then you found me.{p}

You shut me up in this restroom, and I couldn't bring them food anymore.
Do you think I hated you?
You hated me
You didn't hate me

That's right, I didn't hate you.
No, that's not quite true.
At first, I did hate you.
I'd finally been able to bring food to the cubs, and then this.
But soon, that hatred faded away.
Because you called me by my name...{p}

At first, I was worried you'd realized I'd turned into a tanuki.
But that didn't seem to be it.
You'd only given the tanuki my name because you were pining for me.
I was happy.
When I found out there was someone who cared about me.
Honestly, sometimes I thought, if only I'd known before I died... but you took such devoted care of me that I didn't mind.{p}

...But because of a heartless boy, I had to die all over again.
You know about that too, don't you.{p}

Even so, you made me a grave and took care of it every day like this.
Thanks to you, I think I'll be able to pass on..."
"Huh? Pass on...?"
Hearing that she would pass on shook him.
He'd finally been able to see Yoshida again, and now she was going to pass on...
Even if she was a ghost, he wanted to be with her.
"Yes. Thanks to you, I can rest in peace and pass on.
Thank you...
I wanted to tell you that, so today I appeared before you like this."
"No!
I thought I'd finally gotten to see you, and now I'll never see you again...
You don't have to pass on.
Stay with me forever!"
He begged Yoshida desperately.{p}What do you think she said?
I can't do that
All right

"All right...
Thank you.
I'm so happy you care about me that much.
But promise me just this one thing.
No matter what happens, don't ever come to hate me."
"I promise.
I'll never, ever hate you.
I promise.
So stay with me forever..."
She agreed.
On one condition: she couldn't leave that restroom.
He was overjoyed.
But he should have thought it through.
What it meant for her to stay there instead of passing on.
Every day after school, he went to that restroom to meet her.
Just as if they were going on dates.
That went on for several months.{p}

But you know, little by little, her face began to change.
Gradually, it took on a vicious look.
Little by little, he came to be afraid of her.
Even her slightest gestures, even her smile, began to fill him with fear.
She noticed that about him, too.
So she pressed him on it.
You'll never come to hate me, no matter how long it's been, will you?
But you know, when he saw her face at that moment, he got scared.
It felt like she was threatening him.
And that made her furious.{p}

"You said so!
You said you'd never hate me.
And yet you...
You... Youuuu☆"
She lunged at him.
Her face was no longer the face she'd had.
